lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-intensity circular clusters arranged in approximately six identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill region. The centroids exhibit a consistent 2D spacing, forming a quasi-rectilinear grid in the mid-lateral area.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-luminance bands intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, creating a grid-like pattern where the largest blobs occupy the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: One distinct longitudinal ridge is visible in the upper quadrant, displaying a sharp luminance transition from a high-intensity dorsal edge to a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are visible: one attached to the ventral base of the pectoral fin, and several others trailing along the lower flank and ventral region.
